pool.text: The lord of the manor secured the right to hold a market
Harwich was granted its first charter to become a recognized borough
French forces launched an abortive military raid against the coastal town
Harwich Dockyard was established as an official naval dockyard facility
The town became a naval base and was heavily fortified
A pair of lighthouses was set up on the Town Green
The dockyard ceased to operate as a Royal Dockyard for warships
The Harwich Guildhall was built as a notable listed structure
The High Lighthouse was constructed as part of maritime navigation
The Great Eastern Main Line arrived from Colchester to connect travellers
The Pier Hotel was established on the quayside for arriving travellers
The chapel of St Nicholas was upgraded to a parish church
The Electric Palace Cinema was built with an ornamental frontage
The Great Eastern Hotel was closed by the newly formed LNER
The two local parishes were merged into a single parish
The historic borough of Harwich was abolished under legislation
The Royal Naval Auxiliary Service maintained a headquarters on site until this year
The Trinity House office building was completed next door
A sea shanty festival was set up to run annually in October
